This salad is very easy to make. 

== Ingredients ==
* 8 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] [[Cookbook:Imitation Crab|imitation crab]] meat
* 16 oz canned whole kernel sweet [[Cookbook:Corn|corn]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[cookbook:mayonnaise|mayonnaise]]
* 1–2 [[cookbook:Green Onion|green onions]]
* Shredded cheese (optional)

== Procedure ==
# [[cookbook:Chop|Chop]] imitation crab meat and green onions.
# Combine the above, corn and mayonnaise in an appropriately-sized bowl.
# Mix well.
# Add shredded cheese to taste and mix again.
